description.value: Gateway to India is an Indian restaurant in Nanaimo serving authentic dishes made with exotic spices imported from the northern and southern regions of the Indian subcontinent. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, with an extensive menu of tandoor-baked breads, curries, pakoras, and a broad selection of vegetarian dishes. Their spice products are also sold at grocery stores across Vancouver Island and the Lower Mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and corroborates the OSM address (202 Fourth St, Nanaimo BC V9R 1T2). The home page explicitly states 'Open for Take-Out & Dine-In', confirming takeout. The menu page lists a dedicated 'VEGETARIAN OPTIONS' section and calls out 'PAPPADUM 5 GLUTEN FREE', confirming vegetarian and GF options. No website evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
